pattern: creating a worktree in the shell and moving into it by hand
experience: An agent already working in a worktree needed a fresh worktree for the same conversation.
rule: Use t3_worktree_handoff to create a worktree and move this thread into it, even when the thread already works in another worktree. End the current turn afterward.

pattern: launching a new worktree thread or running git worktree add when asked to continue in a worktree
experience: Asked to make a worktree and keep working there, an agent could start a new thread or create the checkout in the shell, losing the conversation or leaving T3 pointed at the old folder.
rule: To move this thread into a new worktree, call t3_worktree_handoff. Do not start a thread or run git worktree add.
